# Bengali legacy fonts

Upload Bengali legacy font files here: the `.ttf` (or `.otf`) files, with
every style of a font (Normal, Bold, Italic, Wide...). Like everything in
`vendor/`, they are never published by the website.

## How to upload

1. On GitHub, open this folder and choose **Add file -> Upload files**.
2. Drag in the font files, or a whole folder per font (GitHub keeps the
   folder name, e.g. `LMG Arun/LMG-Arun.ttf`). Loose files are fine too:
   they get sorted into one folder per font when the map is built.
3. Commit straight to `main`.

A real Word document typed in the font (personal details removed) helps a
lot: it is the only way a converter leaves Beta. Put it next to the font,
e.g. `LMG Arun/sample-letter.docx`.

## Fonts wanted

- SutonnyMJ
- SolaimanLipi (ANSI version)
- Kalpurush ANSI
- Bijoy fonts (any ...MJ)
- Siyam Rupali ANSI

Once at least one font is read key by key, `/bengali-font-converter` goes live
(it shows "Soon" until then).

Most Bengali legacy text was typed with Bijoy in a "...MJ" font, such as SutonnyMJ.
